name: The Citizens Foundation USA
mission:
The Citizens Foundation, USA (TCF-USA) is a professionally managed tax-exempt charity, with a support network of volunteer chapters across the USA. We support the building of civil society in Pakistan by providing quality education to underprivileged children, promoting gender equality & partnering for reform of public education. We believe that education is a basic human right. Universal access to education is a prerequisite for democratic institutions to flourish in Pakistan and for its people to compete in a global economy.
TCF currently has 1,833 schools in all the provinces of Pakistan with 280,000 children enrolled, nearly half of them girls. TCF has trained and employed 13,000 women as teachers and principals, making it the largest employer of women in the private sector.
TCF also provides scholarships for tertiary education to the deserving graduates of its' secondary schools and an adult literacy program that has transformed the lives of women.
theoryOfChange: Providing quality education to underprivileged children, promoting gender equality and advocating for reform of public education to build civil society.

rich_narrative.summary: The Citizens Foundation USA (TCF-USA) is a highly effective educational nonprofit that supports one of the largest networks of independently run schools in Pakistan. Founded in <cite id="1">1995</cite>, the organization focuses on removing barriers of class and privilege by providing <cite id="2">quality education to underprivileged children</cite>. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="3">$18,303,365 in total revenue</cite> to fund its mission. The organization operates with exceptional financial efficiency, reporting a <cite id="4">89.5% program expense ratio</cite> in its latest filings. This lean operational model allows the charity to maintain a remarkably low <cite id="5">cost of $55.37 per beneficiary</cite>, which is considered exceptional for the global education sector. Beyond primary and secondary schooling, TCF-USA supports <cite id="6">volunteer, alumni, and community programs</cite> to ensure long-term student success. The charity is a <cite id="7">verified zakat-eligible organization</cite>, specifically serving the asnaf categories of <cite id="8">fuqara (the poor) and masakin (the needy)</cite>. With a <cite id="9">perfect 100/100 score in Leadership and Culture</cite> from Charity Navigator, the organization demonstrates a mature institutional framework capable of large-scale impact. Its direct service model ensures that funds are used to build and operate schools directly, rather than just providing indirect support.
